title: 7 Sins a Godly Man Has Quietly Renamed Something Softer
caption:
The name change is the reason it's still alive.

Lust gets called "just how guys are wired." Envy gets called "staying motivated." Cowardice gets called "keeping the peace." Isolation gets called "handling it myself."

Laziness gets called "resting." Self-pity gets called "processing." Contempt gets called "just being honest."

1 Corinthians 6:12 says everything's permissible, but not everything gets to be your master. Call it what it actually is. That's the first thing that has to die before it does.
